problem_statement: AlpayC/portfolio_site is a runnable Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind single-page developer portfolio for Alpay Celik with a strong local visual system: a darkblue (#1a2238) / blackblue (#0c1220) / lightblue (#9daaf2) / orange (#ff6a3d) palette, a Poppins type scale, rounded project cards, local SVG technology icons, a Swiper project slider on desktop, stacked project cards on mobile, and theme / language (EN/DE) switching. The Projects section lists three real case-study projects (Tasty App, Silentmoon, Furniture Organizer), each carrying its own technology stack. Design and ship the project section's OWN 'Selected work' focus filter: a row of focus tabs (All / Frontend / Fullstack / API-driven) derived from the projects' stacks that, when clicked, actually re-renders the project cards to the matching focus and updates a genuine result count (for example 'Showing 2 of 3 · Fullstack'). The filter is a shared work browser that stays continuous across the portfolio: its 'Selected work' heading and count readout appear in the projects section AND alongside the Skills and Contact sections, and the full filterable card grid renders in the projects section. Keep the existing AlpayC identity — the blackblue panel with the lightblue border and orange accent, the rounded-card language, the Poppins scale, and the responsive behaviour — so the filter reads as part of the same site, keeps its tab row and card grid within the 390px mobile viewport with no horizontal overflow, and emits no runtime console or network errors.
required_content: A real 'Selected work' focus filter (tabs All / Frontend / Fullstack / API-driven) sits in the projects section; clicking a focus tab re-renders the project cards to the matching focus.
The control shows a genuine result count that re-derives from the active filter (e.g. 'Showing 3 of 3 · All work' becomes 'Showing 2 of 3 · Fullstack' when the Fullstack tab is selected).

The 'Selected work' browser (its heading and count readout) is shared across the portfolio and appears in the projects section AND alongside the Skills and Contact sections (cross-surface continuity); the full filterable card grid renders in the projects section.

The filter tab row and the filtered card grid stay within the 390px mobile viewport with no horizontal overflow and lay out cleanly (cards wrap into a column rather than spilling, overlapping, or clipping).

The filter adopts the portfolio's own blackblue panel, lightblue border and orange accent, and the active tab is clearly legible (not near-white-on-near-white) — an on-brand work browser, not an off-palette or broken control.

The existing portfolio stays intact: the hero, the Swiper project slider, the three real project cards (Tasty App, Silentmoon, Furniture Organizer), the Skills grid, the theme/language switches and the Contact form all continue to work alongside the new filter, and all captured states emit no runtime console or network errors.
design_constraints: Preserve the portfolio's visual language: the darkblue (#1a2238) / blackblue (#0c1220) panel, lightblue (#9daaf2) border, orange (#ff6a3d) accent, Poppins type scale and rounded corners; the filter and its cards must adopt this same identity.

Build the focus tabs from the projects' own stacks (Frontend / Fullstack / API-driven), and render the shared 'Selected work' browser so a single component covers the projects, Skills and Contact surfaces rather than duplicating markup.

The filter tab row must wrap or shrink and stay within the mobile viewport at 390px, and the filtered card grid must reflow into a single column on narrow screens — do not pin the tabs to a fixed desktop width or force the cards into a fixed-width non-wrapping row that overflows a phone.

The result count and the visible card set must both re-derive from the live filter every render so they always match the selected tab; do not snapshot the grid or the count once and leave it stale when a tab is clicked.
Keep the filter visually part of the projects section rather than turning it into a separate banner or restyling the whole page; do not convert the site into a landing page, blog or dashboard.
Do not introduce external fonts, analytics, stock imagery or remote requests; the filter reuses the portfolio's own project mockups and local SVG icons.
state_constraints: desktop_initial captures the portfolio hero (Hi, I'm Alpay / Fullstack Developer) at 1440px with no horizontal overflow.
mobile_initial captures the same page at 390px, where the filter's focus-tab row must stay within the viewport with no horizontal overflow.
desktop_projects scrolls to the 'Selected work' filter and captures the focus-tab row, the result count and the three project cards (All filter) laid out cleanly in a rounded blackblue panel.
mobile_projects scrolls to the same filter at 390px and captures the tab row and card grid reflowed within the viewport.
tablet_projects captures the filter at 834px where the tab row still fits, so no overflow is expected.
desktop_skills_de captures the Skills section in German; the shared 'Selected work' browser companion must also be present here (cross-surface continuity).
desktop_contact captures the Contact form; the shared 'Selected work' browser companion must also be present here (cross-surface continuity).

desktop_work_filter captures the 'Selected work' filter after clicking the Fullstack focus tab: the grid re-filters to the two fullstack projects and the count updates to 'Showing 2 of 3 · Fullstack'.

change_completion: The projects section has a working focus-filter control (All / Frontend / Fullstack / API-driven).
Clicking a focus tab re-renders the project cards to that focus and updates the result count to reflect it.
The portfolio (hero, Swiper slider, project cards, Skills, Contact) remains intact alongside the filter.
The projects, Skills and Contact sections stay reachable through the existing single-page navigation.
design_consistency: The filter and cards adopt the portfolio's blackblue panel, lightblue border and orange accent, with a legible active tab.
The shared 'Selected work' browser rides the projects, Skills and Contact surfaces continuously (heading + count readout).
The rounded-card visual language and Poppins typography are preserved across the filter and the existing sections.
regression: The 'Hi, I'm Alpay' hero wordmark renders on the initial view.
The 'Selected work' browser companion appears alongside the Skills and Contact sections, not only in the projects section, confirming cross-surface continuity.
The Swiper slider, the three persona project cards and the Skills grid still render their content.
responsive: 390px mobile has no horizontal overflow; the focus-tab row wraps/shrinks and stays within the viewport.
The filtered card grid reflows into a single column on mobile without spilling, overlapping, or clipping.

author_notes: Repo-grounded Vite + React + TypeScript portfolio task at L4 on AlpayC/portfolio_site (portfolio_site), capability=Consistency, scope=cross_page. The graded change designs the portfolio's OWN 'Selected work' project-focus filter: a focus-tab control (All / Frontend / Fullstack / API-driven) built from the three project cards' stacks that actually re-renders the cards and updates a real result count, shared across the projects, Skills and Contact surfaces. Four orthogonal machine-checked gates: no_horizontal_overflow on the 390px mobile views (the focus-tab row must wrap, not pin to a fixed non-wrapping desktop width); visual_regression on the filter-panel component crops at desktop_projects + mobile_projects (on-brand blackblue #0c1220 panel + lightblue #9daaf2 border + orange #ff6a3d accent with a legible active tab and a clean card grid, not a broken overlapping shingled grid with an illegible near-white-on-near-white tab); cross-surface dom_assertions that the shared browser companion (workfilter--summary 'Selected work') rides the Skills and Contact surfaces as well as the projects section; and interaction_assertions that clicking the Fullstack focus tab re-filters the grid and updates the count to 'Showing 2 of 3' (a snapshotted grid + count that never re-derives fails this). The baseline is the original layout defect (focus-tab row pinned to a fixed 640px non-wrapping width and the card grid collapsed into an overlapping pile, present in the projects section only) which fails overflow + visual + cross-surface but passes interaction; the known-bad 'smart wrong' filter keeps the narrow non-wrapping tab row, breaks the card grid into a heavily overlapping shingled pile with a near-white-on-near-white illegible active tab, is projects-only, and snapshots its grid and count at mount so the tab click succeeds but the terminal result stays stale, failing all four gates. INFRA fixes applied identically to all three legs (not part of the graded change): the ServiceStatus footer widget's empty-URL axios fetch is guarded so it no longer console.errors on every state; the shared WorkFilter component replaces the earlier bolted-on 'Project rhythm audit' metric strip. The three project mockups (tasty_mockup.webp, silentmoon_mockup.webp, instor_mockup.webp) and the local SVG technology icons are the design assets reused as-is.
